findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qm_scrub, qm_validate_machine_files, qm_attest_verify, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_catalog, qm_buy · Private data: qm_scrub, qm_validate_machine_files, qm_probe_endpoint, qm_attest, qm_attest_verify, qm_second_opinion, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_clinic_checkup, qm_clinic_stats, qm_catalog, qm_buy, qm_data_iss_pass, qm_data_summarize · Public sink: qm_scrub, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_buy · Destructive: qm_second_opinion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qm_scrub, qm_validate_machine_files, qm_attest_verify, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_catalog, qm_buy · Private data: qm_scrub, qm_validate_machine_files, qm_probe_endpoint, qm_attest, qm_attest_verify, qm_second_opinion, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_clinic_checkup, qm_clinic_stats, qm_catalog, qm_buy, qm_data_iss_pass, qm_data_summarize · Public sink: qm_scrub, qm_clinic_diagnose, qm_buy · Destructive: qm_second_opinion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
